list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written in our own words for this entry.

trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to chase directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles, crime and money — and this one pops last. If it has not popped after 54, check the tracker: one trophy is still unchecked.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — official trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is the first mission of the game. It is story progress, so it cannot be missed — just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone; missions can be replayed from the mission menu if one is ever failed, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 2 until the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is pure story progress: finish the chapter and it pops, and a failed mission can simply be replayed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 3 until the chapter closes. It is story progress only, so keep pushing the main missions and it will pop at the chapter's end; nothing in this chapter locks it out.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 4 until the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the rest it only needs the chapter finished — replay any failed mission and carry on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission to earn this gold. It is the story's last beat, so it pops at the end of a full playthrough; save before the finale if you want a clean rollback point for the choice-based trophies, then finish the mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the story reaches it; finish the mission and the trophy pops. If the mission is failed, replay it — story missions do not lock you out of their trophies.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are long, so expect several stages and checkpoints; reaching the end of the mission is all the trophy asks, and a failed attempt can be retried from the last checkpoint.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the mission-complete screen; nothing extra is needed, and failing the mission only sends you back to a checkpoint to try again.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends; play it through, use checkpoints after a failed attempt, and it will unlock as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting matters later too — remember this location, because the unscheduled-departure trophy also happens at VCIA. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named story missions, so it unlocks in order as the story reaches it; finish it and the trophy pops, with checkpoints covering any failed attempt.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which PSN tracks as a percentage across story, side content, collectibles and activities. Do not chase this first: finish the story, clear the side strands and collectibles, and the percentage climbs on its own. The in-game stats page shows exactly what is still missing, so check it before grinding anything blind. This gold is the last big gate before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (100% completion)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the running total PSN tracks. The fastest honest route is to repeat short stunt-friendly runs rather than hunting one-offs: pick a fast car, a ramp or jump you can hit reliably, and loop it. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt from the story onward already counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (250 stunts)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — the game counts each distinct activity you sample. Work through the activity list methodically and tick each one off in the tracker as you try it: shooting range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races and one more activity type the game offers. One try each is enough; no score or win is needed.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (9 activity types)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every weapon challenge at every range, at gold standard. This is the grind trophy of the activities set: learn each weapon's recoil and the scoring windows, and clear the easier challenges first to build the habit. Gold in all 42 is required, not just a pass, so expect repeat attempts on the hardest ones.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (42 challenges)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so work through them one by one and note which are done in the tracker. Learn the racing line for each course — cutting corners cleanly beats raw speed — and retry any lost race on the spot.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (14 locations)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Race variety is the point: enter events across Leonida, in different vehicles and disciplines, and keep a mental note of which you have won. Wins from the story and side content count too, so this total builds up naturally if you race whenever the chance appears.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (20 races)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him in the head-to-head: land the better catch within the challenge's rules. Fishing rewards patience and the right spot, so if one attempt fails, try a different cast point and challenge him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade cabinet counts, so pick the game you find easiest and play it through to its end screen. It is a single completion, not a high score — finishing is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances, so keep returning to Andy whenever new missions appear, and the trophy pops when his last one ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Work through his missions in order as they unlock; the strand ends with his last mission, and the trophy pops there.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep doing Billy's missions as they appear; his strand closes with the final one, and the trophy pops at its end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 separate stranger mission strands across Leonida — the Strangers & Freaks-style encounters scattered around the state. Each strand is its own small story with several missions, so this is a long one: explore, take every stranger mission you find, and finish each strand fully. Eight completed strands earn this silver; half-finished ones do not count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (8 strands)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Do his missions as they unlock across the story; the trophy pops when the strand's last mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Work his missions in order as they appear; the strand closes with his final mission, and the trophy pops there.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole state, so treat this as an exploration trophy: visit each one, sit down and meditate, and tick it off in the tracker. Pair it with the explore-all-of-Leonida trophy to cover ground efficiently.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (18 spots)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Talk to Bret to learn which animal and where it roams, then track it down — unique hunts need patience and a quiet approach, so bring the right weapon and do not spook it. Deliver the hunt to Bret to close the strand.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so this is a collection grind: gather cards as you explore, and keep sets together — a set only counts once every card in it is found. Finish three sets for this silver; the tracker notes which sets you have closed.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (3 sets)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. This is a volume trophy, so fold it into everything else you do: WAiNK at every new spot you pass instead of saving it for a dedicated run. The count is cumulative, and 100 locations takes a full playthrough of exploring, so start early and it will finish itself.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (100 locations)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunts, shooting, driving and more — and they stack up across a playthrough. Do not grind fifty of one type; sample widely, and the counter climbs as you clear the activity trophies anyway.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (50 challenges)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. MISSABLE in practice: the trophy needs your partner present and a full 4-star heat, a setup that is easiest during story missions where your partner is with you — do it there, in open country where you can break line of sight, and do not let the wanted level drop below 4 stars before you escape.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level — easiest during story missions with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the heat must stay on from the first robbery to the third. MISSABLE in practice: it needs your partner and three shops close together, so plan the route first, hit the shops in order, and keep moving so the wanted level never clears. A failed run can be retried, but only while your partner is available.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner and 3 shops in a row with the wanted level kept the whole time.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Just driving and entering new vehicles counts them, so this builds up by itself if you try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you meet instead of sticking to one favourite. The counter is cumulative across the playthrough.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (100 vehicles)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster: enter a fight with several foes in view, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns quickly. If the focus ends early or an enemy escapes, retry the same fight — it is repeatable, not a one-shot chance.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule never planned — an unscheduled departure, in the game's own words. MISSABLE in practice: it needs a specific exit from VCIA, so do it while the airport is open to you during the story, in a vehicle you can drive straight out with, rather than assuming you can come back to it later.
trophies.missableNote: A specific exit from VCIA — do it while the airport is open to you during the story.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks, as the description hints. Get into a confrontation involving Rhino tanks and come out on top; heavy weapons and cover help, and the trophy pops once the Rhino situation is resolved. It is repeatable, so a failed attempt just means trying the encounter again.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected the whole time — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Plan the entry, move quietly, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, but the robbery can be tried again, so treat a failure as a rehearsal.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies, so plan each: get in, take the vault, and get clear before the response arrives. Five successful escapes earn this silver — the count is cumulative, so each vault you finish stays banked.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (5 vaults)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck, rob it, and escape. Trucks run set routes, so watch one, hit it when it is isolated, take the takings and break away before the response closes in. One clean escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This is the map-completion trophy: visit every named area of the state, from Vice City out to the swamps and keys. Drive the roads, take the side routes, and check the map for grey areas you have not set foot in yet. Pair it with meditation spots, WAiNK locations and card hunting to cover ground once, not three times.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (52 areas)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida, so this is a tour of the underworld: find each gang's operation, rob it, and move to the next. Nine gangs, nine robberies — keep a note of which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (9 gangs)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer — so walk the beachfront until the prompt appears and take the drink in. Any visit works; it is not tied to a mission.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out through a showroom's frontage, smashing your way out in classic style. MISSABLE in practice: it needs a showroom you can drive through, so do it the first time you are in a showroom with a vehicle — once a showroom is smashed or the story moves on, the clean setup may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a drivable exit through a showroom — do it the first time you are in one with a vehicle.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a game there. The trophy is about the visit and the follow-through, not a score, so play the lane properly and it pops. It also counts toward trying each activity type.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description points at a shared moment with your partner that lands with an audience. MISSABLE in practice: partnership moments happen in specific story beats, so when a scene offers a shared, public moment with your partner, take it rather than skipping past it.
trophies.missableNote: A shared public moment with your partner — take it when a story beat offers it.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count of 500. Choices happen all through the game, in dialogue and in mission decisions, so this is a cumulative total that grows as you play and decide. MISSABLE in practice: some choices are one-time story decisions, so decide deliberately at each choice point instead of rushing past, and keep a separate save before big decisions.
trophies.missableNote: PSN tracks 500 choices; some are one-time story decisions — keep a save before big ones.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (500 choices)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then get it right the second time. MISSABLE in practice: the trophy needs a genuine first failure followed by a success, so if you are perfect at everything, it will not pop. The natural way is to let a failed attempt happen during normal play and then clear the same thing immediately after.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a real first failure followed by a success — do not reload away every failed attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description points at one of the game's odd, unscripted-feeling events. MISSABLE in practice: strange events are rare and often one-time, so when something odd happens, stay and watch it play out instead of driving on. Exploring off the beaten path raises the odds of finding one.
trophies.missableNote: A rare one-time strange event — stay and watch when something odd happens.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and connect. It is repeatable, so keep trying drive-bys until one lands; speed matters less than timing the swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, so the laundering total grows as you do the crime trophies — feed bills to your contacts whenever you have them rather than hoarding them. The count is cumulative, so $250,000 across the playthrough is the target.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target ($250,000)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles, anything sold in a shop. The total is cumulative, so normal buying across a playthrough gets most of the way there; top it up late with big purchases like vehicles once the other money trophies are in hand.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target ($100,000)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages cost money, so save for them as the laundering and robbery income comes in; each one is a separate purchase, and the trophy pops when the eighth is yours. They also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles the discovery trophy needs.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (8 properties)
Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app and register each one — ten different registrations is the target. Pair it with the discover-100-vehicles trophy: register as you discover, and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (10 vehicles)
Own advice from the official description
